Web search.d: A Claude feature that lets it search the public web and read pages during a chat, showing citations for what it found. On all plans; Team and Enterprise owners must enable it.

Research mode.d: A Claude feature (paid plans) that runs many linked web and connector searches for a broad question and writes a longer, sourced report.

Citation.d: A link or quote showing which source a claim came from. It shows where an AI says it got the claim, not that the claim is correct.

Chat memory.d: Claude app feature that saves lasting facts about you and your work as editable topics and applies them in new chats. Separate from Claude Code's CLAUDE.md memory.

Instructions for Claude.d: Standing instructions you write in your Claude settings that apply to every conversation, such as preferred format or spelling. Older guides call them profile preferences.

Incognito chat.d: A temporary Claude chat that isn't saved to your history or memory. It is still kept for 30 days by default and, on work plans, can appear in organisation exports.

Snapshot link.d: A shared-chat link that shows the conversation as it was when shared. Later messages and attached files are not included.
